remarks: This spacious and updated three-bedroom, two-full-bath condominium presents a turnkey opportunity in a sought-after location close to Stamford Train Station. It is ideally located accessible to Stamford Downtown while offering easy access to I-95. The townhouse-style expansive open floor plan is enhanced by brilliant recessed lighting on main floor and lower level and hardwood floors throughout. The stylish kitchen has been fully renovated and features stainless steel appliances, granite countertops with a large island, and ample storage, seamlessly connecting to the dining and family areas. The family room offers a generous layout with a central location for entertainment. On the second floor, the large primary bedroom includes two closets on opposing sides of the space and the well-sized second bedroom includes one closet. The shared full bath is easily accessible in the immediate hallway across from an additional closet. The lower level features and additional bedroom with backyard access, an office/laundry room with attached updated full bath, and additional storage with access to 2022 new boiler and hot water heater. The fenced backyard provides for private enjoyment of the leveled grassy landscaping and garden with blue stone patio and elevated deck. Street parking directly in front of unit allows for easy access to all the amenities the area has to offer. Washer/dryer, AC units included! Monthly rent includes water and sewer. Make this your new home today!
